notes: «وقال حماد أيضا عن عبيد الله بن عمر» (مثله) names another transmitter for the saying: variant, not a route of the first (rule 4)
«وحديث عقبة بن سويد» and «وحديث عمر بن الخطاب» are other versions of the saying named by Abu Dawud: variant groups
Abu Dawud's remarks on the added words and on «ليست بمحفوظة» name transmitters but carry no route of their own: left out
«بإسناد قتيبة» points to Qutayba's chain, not in this context: kept as back_reference
